cm = reraise(ValueError, TypeError)
print(f"Has __call__: {hasattr(cm, '__call__')}")
print(f"Has __enter__: {hasattr(cm, '__enter__')}")
print(f"Has __exit__: {hasattr(cm, '__exit__')}")

def my_func():
    return 42

try:
    result = cm(my_func)
    print(f"cm(my_func) returned: {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"cm(my_func) raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
